notes.title: We have added markers to the first level to make it easier......
notes.notes:
[h2]We have added markers to the first level to make it easier to complete all tasks. But only on the first level. On the next levels, You will need to use Your mind and observation skills because we believe You can handle it on Your own.  

Remember that  - You can switch between levels using the keys 1, 2, 3, 4.[/h2]

notes.title: The game does not have a save system.... BUT !i!i!
notes.notes:
The game does not have a save system, but you can skip through levels using the 1, 2, 3, and 4 keys. 

Look for artifacts that will increase your movement speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150157/f2a38ff02557e5ef430b49ca95aeaba41cbb052e.png[/img]
